replication.target_description: Final replication of original Study 2: one-way ANOVA comparing high-level action identification in liked versus disliked conditions.

n.location: p. 38, Table 12 note; p. 39, Table 13 note
n.exclusions: Analyses use verification-passing participants; project-wide 65 of 1151 excluded. Condition-specific exclusion counts not reported here.

reported_success.quote: We successfully replicated the results of Study 2 and found support for the liking effect on action identification and mind attribution.

notes: The supplied OSF file URL resolves to a preregistration manuscript explicitly using simulated Qualtrics data. Those simulated statistics were not used. The completed author preprint was obtained from the registered-from project hw4av, Preprint folder, file hn6xt; its title/authors, original studies and final-result page locators match the assignment. No conversions performed. Where a locator covers action identification and mind attribution, the high-level action-identification test is selected; the other outcome is described in notes. Description includes two distinct outcomes. Selected action identification because it is the first target result on supplied original p. 4 and replication p. 37; not possible to uniquely disambiguate from neutral description alone. The separately reported overall mind-attribution test is original F(1,33)=10.07, p<.01, η²=.23 (p.547) and replication F(1,317)=73.67, p<.001, η²=.19 (p.37); those are not mixed into the selected effect.
